integrity: Every finite cell and integral boundary coefficient is recomputed by standalone Python code; no independent mathematical review.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite cellular homology of the displayed cubical complex, not a general homology or homotopy theorem. Computation relies on the standard within-color disjoint-support and all-vertex coverage definitions.
title: Two independent integral two-torsion classes in a grouped Stirling complex on the complete four-vertex graph
